extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.17.20 - BingeTV: no volume icon when a muted trailer starts or stops. v0.17.19 - BingeTV: hub pages laid out like Home, with trailers; the info page uses Home's centred layout with chips. v0.17.18 - BingeTV: minimal chips; the description shows at 2 seconds and stays while a trailer loads. v0.17.17 - BingeTV: the focused title in a centred column, with its date, length, rating and genres as chips and its description after 2 seconds. v0.17.16 - BingeTV: the playing stream's badges (4K, Dolby Vision, Atmos, ...) show in the OSD under "Ends at". v0.17.15 - BingeTV: a Home trailer only starts when YouTube is ready for it (Kodi could hang for a minute when it wasn't). v0.17.14 - BingeTV: Home's trailers can play muted (Settings > Home page layout; on to start with). v0.17.13 - BingeTV trailers on Home: a black background while one plays, and the focus stays on the title while it loads. v0.17.12 - BingeTV: trailers on Home. Turn on "Play trailers on Home" (Settings > Home page layout): when a title stays focused (3 to 10 seconds, your choice), its trailer plays at the top right.
